summary.text: Brad Slagh, listed by Ballotpedia as Bradley Slagh, is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 85 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists his House service as beginning in 2019.
A realtor and former Ottawa County Treasurer, he serves on the House Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Slagh earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from Hope College.
His career includes work as a partner in a family-owned property management business, as a realtor and in financial services.
He served as Zeeland Township Supervisor and as Ottawa County Treasurer.
Slagh has served on the House Appropriations Committee in each session since 2019.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Richard Abraham in the general election on November 3, 2026.
